_README: Copy this file to EI_ControlTower/twillo.json and fill real values.
Never commit twillo.json; it contains secrets.
All phone numbers must be E.164 format, ex: +15551234567.
_PRODUCTION_CHECKLIST: TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID starts with AC and is 34 chars total.
TWILIO_API_KEY_SID starts with SK and is 34 chars total.
TWILIO_TWIML_APP_SID starts with AP and is 34 chars total.
TWILIO_CALLER_ID is your Twilio voice-capable number in E.164.
DESTINATION_DEVICE is the phone/SIP/client target in E.164, sip:, or client: format.
TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN matches the account used by TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID.
